title: manage_saved_cards
description: List a payer's saved payment methods, or set which one their invoices are charged to. Read and select only — removing a method is done by its owner, not by an agent or a script.

op.description: list returns every method on this payer's processor customer plus which is selected; select makes one of them the method their invoices charge.

contact_id.description: Whose methods. The payer — an invoice's `customer`.

payment_method_id.description: Required for select: which method, from a list call.

from_customers.description: Extra processor customers this contact may draw a method from. A method only charges against the customer it hangs off, so selecting one from elsewhere stores that customer too.
